name: specula-workspace
description: Specula — a bidirectional bridge between rendered DOM and source AST.

scripts.build: npm run build:instrument && npm run build:overlay
scripts.build:instrument: cd specula-instrument && cargo build --release -p specula-analyze -p specula-edit && cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip1 -p specula-swc-plugin
scripts.test: npm run test:instrument && npm run test:daemon && npm run test:overlay && npm run test:cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @specula/daemon && npm run typecheck --workspace @specula/overlay
